usages.explain: Expresses the feeling of refuting the opponent's doubts about oneself after receiving their words. Used in casual spoken language.

examples.content: 一人で持てるの。持てるったら。
examples.transcription: いちにんでもてるの。もてるったら。
examples.mean: I can have it by myself. If I could have it.

examples.content: 薬を飲んだの。飲んだったら。
examples.transcription: くすりをのんだの。のんだったら。
examples.mean: I took some medicine. If you drink.

title: …ったら => speaking of; I told you already
